about: What a customer surface must never carry (owner directive 2026-11-03, section 2; CORE-UX-DESIGN.md section 0.6): provider and model identities, usage/token/credit fields, request/response ids and sha256-like hex, trace links, retrieval logs, rule ids and orchestration machinery. One list, read by the walk (ops/walk.cjs: every customer API JSON response and header and the DOM text; the PDF downloads - their wording and their answers - are scanned by ops/scan_customer.py, and the walk records them as skipped, never as its own pass) and ops/scan_customer.py (every customer endpoint and export; the Django suite scans the server's payloads through it); the vectors below are run by their tests, so the readers cannot drift apart. The Fable coding build (2026-11-20, BUILD-SPEC 6 and 7.4) kept the vendor and model names, tokens, credits, sha256, provider, request id and /ops/ rules, dropped the earlier architecture's words (participant, peer review, harness and the rule-id prefixes routing, participant, peer and harness) and the forbidden keys of records that no longer exist, and added the coding round's internal keys; the server's display filter (studio/customer.py shown, which replaces a vendor or model name in the coding review's own text with 'the system') repeats the four name rules, and tests/test_api_customer.py pins the two equal. The operator console is server-rendered HTML since that build, so no operator JSON gives deny values (deny_value_paths is empty). Patterns are matched case-insensitively and ASCII-only (JavaScript 'gi' without 'u'; Python re.ASCII | re.IGNORECASE), after every 'allowed' string is removed; a pattern marked "case_sensitive": true is matched ASCII-only with its case as written (JavaScript 'g'; Python re.ASCII). A model family's name (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) is a name only where it continues a vendor's name, which the display filter then replaces whole ('Claude 3 Opus', 'Claude Sonnet 4.5'); alone it is an ordinary or a clinical word (the OPUS trial, a MED-EL SONNET 2 processor, a haiku), as another company's product named in a note is ('the patient asked ChatGPT'): neither is replaced, and neither is a hit (refutation rounds 1 and 2, 2026-11-21). A bare GPT, or GPT and a number, is not a name, because GPT is also the liver enzyme ALT ('GPT 45 U/L', 'SGPT'): only gpt-<x> is a model id; a plural or a longer word (haikus, sonnets, opuscule, corpus) is not a name, as fables and fabled are not. A provider name is bounded by letters and digits, never by \b, so a joined form (gemini_unknown, reading_gemini_x) is a hit and a clinical word that begins with a name (corticosteroid, cortical) is not (FINAL-V2 4.12 [R:MO-2]); a capitalized name joined to a word by its case alone (GeminiTimeout, readingGemini) is provider_name_joined, matched case-sensitively, so it never matches Corticosteroid or CORTICAL (customer_api.FORBIDDEN's PROVIDER_JOINED, step 3c's fail-closed reading of the joined forms; one net, two readers). A string that is a substring of the encounter's own document text is a quotation of the document and is not scanned (a synthetic patient may be named anything); downloads and bundles are scanned whole. Severity 'soft' records a warning (clinical wording can use the word); 'hard' fails the check.

surfaces.dom: the customer page: every visible or hidden text node, the attributes aria-*, data-*, title, alt, placeholder, value, label, href, src, action and download, the document title, toasts and error text; not the PDF viewer's text layer (#documentViewer .pdf-text), which holds the document's own text as the PDF library reads it (DECISIONS D368), as the framed viewer's content was never read
surfaces.json: every customer API JSON body: its string values and its keys
surfaces.header: every customer API response header value
surfaces.file: every customer download, whole: a report TXT or CSV as its text; a report PDF as the text pypdf extracts from each page, read as a reader sees it (format and other default-ignorable characters deleted, control characters read as spaces): the running header and footer that lead every page alike line by line, and the body of every page as one stream in which only the text inside a printed quotation (between the curly marks the report prints a quotation between, over lines and pages) that is the document's own words is set aside - every other line is the product's wording, scanned whole - with neighbouring lines also read joined over a line break, a page break or a quotation set aside; and its document information values (Title, Author, Subject, Creator, Producer, Keywords and any other entry) - never its raw bytes, whose trailer /ID is 32 hex characters and whose streams are compressed (ops/scan_customer.py read_pdf, scan_pdf); a PDF that cannot be read, or that holds what the scan does not read (bookmarks, a form, page labels, annotations, an image or form object, an XMP stream), is a failed scan, never a pass
surfaces.bundle: the served customer page HTML and every same-origin script and stylesheet it loads, whole (code identifiers such as a CSRF token or a request id variable are not wording, so the wording-only patterns skip it); not the pinned third-party PDF library the page imports on demand to draw a PDF (studio/static/studio/lib/pdfjs-<version>/, DECISIONS D368): byte-identical to its npm package, sealed by sha256 in its MANIFEST.json and by tests/test_frontend.py's own digest of every file, and never CPT Studio's own wording

vectors_note: hits: the sorted, de-duplicated pattern ids a scan of text on that surface must find (deny values and forbidden keys aside); [] for none.
